decision.reason: [ev-dac4ecaa0589] is just a changelog line. It says a controller "cluster batch param" was renamed and added to argocd-cmd-params-cm, but it gives neither the old nor the new flag or key name. It also doesn't say whether the old name still works, or what happens to setups that use it. To write the subject, change (before/after/replacedBy), applicability and consequence, we need the PR #21402 diff or the upgrade guide text that names the parameters and states how they behave.
